sectionDescription: Explore the world of Animal Intelligence through the history of animal civilization, profiles of its undercover agents, and a collection of comics that bring the AIU universe to life with humor.

books.title:
Animal Intelligence History:
The Book of Forgotten Animals
books.description: A story collection exploring history through the eyes of the ancestors of the Animal Intelligence Universe, including extinct species that once shaped the world.

books.title:
Guidebook to the
Animal Intelligence Universe
books.description: A complete guidebook to the seven civilizations of the Animal Intelligence Universe, introducing the animal characters, their cultures, and the roles they play in today's world.

books.title: Watching them humans in the AI age: Animal Intelligence Comics
books.description: A light philosophical comic featuring the characters of the Animal Intelligence Universe, exploring the emotions they experience while observing human society in the age of AI.

books.title: My name is Nacho
books.description:
A novel about the first mission of Nacho, a second-generation secret animal agent. Through Nacho’s journey, we explore what it means to be human and the relationships that shape us.

Just Released!
